title: The Lock-in Hypothesis: Stagnation by Algorithm

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating belief convergence and viewpoint homogenization by simulating human-LLM interactions on polarized political topics (e.g., Trump's election, Citizens United, Ruth Bader Ginsburg's legacy) and measuring the loss of conceptual diversity over time in real-world LLM usage logs (WildChat dataset).

Filtering human-LLM interaction logs (WildChat) for value-laden concepts related to ethics and religion, and calculating the reduction in conceptual diversity over successive LLM version updates using hierarchical clustering and lineage diversity metrics.
